claim: The C0 geodesic in the cusp metric explores the disk in a bounded way with the C0 law (V=C0) holding, conserved cusp energy, a chaos spectrum, and preserved T-symmetry
verdict: REFUTED/unverifiable at the configured settings - same failure mode as metric_comparison: BOTH metrics blow up numerically at dt=0.005 over 5000 steps. Poincare positions go NaN (overflow); the cusp escapes to ~2.7e23 with energy drift 2.68e45 and T-symmetry error 2.8e9. The 'C0 law BROKEN' reading (V range 0-8.15 vs C0=24.43) is an artifact of the escaped trajectory, not a property of the cusp geodesic. The cusp chaos-spectrum question cannot be answered at these settings.
